response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web/full-stack depth, low-latency service work at Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec in D), open-source project ownership, and a solid track record of teaching, workshops, and community mentoring. However, the role's core hard requirement — 8 years of C++ — is not met; his documented C/C++ work spans roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a university thesis project. Likewise, there is no evidence of leading a large-scale cloud compute platform, formal technical leadership/mentoring of cloud or DevOps engineers, or production cloud architecture ownership at the scale described. His experience is centered on TypeScript/Node.js product engineering and D, which does not map to the compute/infrastructure/hardware architecture focus of this position.
strengths: Low-latency distributed systems work at very high request volumes
Broad polyglot experience plus DevOps/CI/CD and Kubernetes exposure
Strong mentoring signal via workshops, courses, and OSS project ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~1 year total)
No formal technical leadership or team-lead role on record
Little large-scale cloud compute platform or hardware architecture work
